name: data-table
description: A server-paged list table. Owns its column definitions as config: it generates the <thead>, maps the positional /explorer row arrays through the config, and keeps the offset cursor tracking the feeds depend on.

action.description: The action name loadDatatablesData turns into an /{COIN}/explorer/<endpoint> URL. Also names the table element: datatable-<action>.

columns.description: Ordered column configs, one per field of the feed's positional row array. Each is { label, cls?, hidden?, order? }. Array order is the FEED's order and is not the theme's to change; `order` permutes the rendered DOM instead.

tableClass.default: table table-striped cell-border view-button table-hover table-condensed
tableClass.description: The <table> class attribute. Two shipped pages drop view-button because they carry no view column.

loading.description: Placeholder text shown until the first draw lands.

query.description: Third argument to loadDatatablesData: the resource a filtered feed is scoped to (a block index, an address, a tick). Null on an unfiltered list page.

type.description: Fourth argument to loadDatatablesData: the feed's sub-selector (history's 'recent', a search's result type).
